dz: 路易十六在雷姆斯被加冕,是法国大革命前最后一次加冕.

dz: 丹麦采用了典型的北欧十字旗，后来被所有其他斯堪的纳维亚国家所采用。

de: Johann Sebastian Bach leads his cantata O Ewigkeit, du Donnerwort (O eternity, you word of thunder), BWV 20, on the first Sunday after Trinity, beginning his second cycle, the chorale cantata cycle.

de: James Scott, Duke of Monmouth, lands at Lyme in Dorset with loyal followers with the intent to depose king James II of England.

t: 腓力二世承认了菲律宾当地贵族和酋长的权利和特权,这为菲律宾本土贵族的精英统治阶级(西班牙裔菲律…

de: Philip II recognizes the rights and privileges of the local nobles and chieftains in the Philippines, which paved way to the stabilization of the rule of the Principalía (an elite ruling class of native nobility in Spanish Philippines).

de: Don Tristan de Luna y Arellano sails for Florida with a party of 1,500, intending to settle on the gulf coast (Vera Cruz, Mexico).

dz: 英国亨利八世与阿拉贡的凯瑟琳结婚。

de: The Treaty of Fotheringhay is signed between the English and Alexander Stewart, Duke of Albany, the rebellious brother of king James III of Scotland.

dz: 百年战争：雅尔若战役开始。
de: Hundred Years' War: Start of the Battle of Jargeau.

dz: 拜占庭帝国首席大臣、海军大都督阿莱克修斯·阿波考科斯被政治犯以私刑杀死。
de: The megas doux Alexios Apokaukos, chief minister of the Byzantine Empire, is lynched by political prisoners.

de: Albert I of Brandenburg, also called The Bear (Ger: Albrecht der Bär), becomes the founder of the Margraviate of Brandenburg, Germany and the first margrave.

t: 佐伊·波弗罗金塔皇后嫁给了君士坦丁·莫诺马乔斯,次日被加冕为拜占庭皇帝.

dz: 佐伊·波弗罗金塔皇后嫁给了君士坦丁·莫诺马乔斯,次日被加冕为拜占庭皇帝.
de: Empress Zoe Porphyrogenita marries Constantine Monomachos, who is crowned the following day as Byzantine Emperor.

de: Lombard Revolt: Greek citizens of Bari rise up against the Lombard rebels led by Melus and deliver the city to Basil Mesardonites, Byzantine governor (catepan) of the Catepanate of Italy.

de: Vladimir the Great consolidates the Kievan realm from Ukraine to the Baltic Sea. He is proclaimed ruler (knyaz) of all Kievan Rus'.

dz: 麦加的一场哈桑德·阿里德起义被阿拔斯人在法克赫战役所粉碎.
de: A Hasanid Alid uprising in Mecca is crushed by the Abbasids at the Battle of Fakhkh.

de: Emperor Taizong of Tang sends envoys to the Xueyantuo bearing gold and silk in order to seek the release of Chinese prisoners captured during the transition from Sui to Tang.

t: 摩拉维亚的罗马军队被已违反和约(171年)的四方包围. 在猛烈的雷暴中,皇帝马库斯·奥雷利乌斯…
te: The Roman army in Moravia is encircled by the Quadi, who have broken the peace treaty (171). In a violent thunderstorm,…
dz: 马可曼尼克之战:摩拉维亚的罗马军队被已违反和约(171年)的四方包围. 在猛烈的雷暴中,皇帝马库斯·奥雷利乌斯在所谓的"雨之奇迹"中击败并制服了他们.
de: Marcomannic Wars: The Roman army in Moravia is encircled by the Quadi, who have broken the peace treaty (171). In a violent thunderstorm, emperor Marcus Aurelius defeats and subdues them in the so-called "miracle of the rain".
